Baker Boy Dominates National Indigenous Music Awards

Baker Boy, a Yolŋu hip-hop artist, was a major winner at the 2026 National Indigenous Music Awards (NIMAs). He secured awards for Album of the Year, Song of the Year, and Film Clip of the Year. The duo Birdz and Fred Leone, who are cousins, were named Artist of the Year. Drifting Clouds received the award for Best New Talent. Baker Boy dedicated his wins to his late grandmother.
